title: Deadline: Disney+ Cancels New Power Rangers Series
content:
Percy Jackson and the Olympians showrunners Jonathan E. Steinberg and Dan Shotz were brought on to produce the show. Hasbro would have also produced the show.

Power Rangers Dino Fury , the latest series in the Power Rangers franchise , premiered on Nickelodeon in February 2021. The series is based on, and repurposes footage from, Kishiryū Sentai Ryūsoulger . The show's second season debuted on Netflix in March 2022. The third season, titled Power Rangers Cosmic Fury , debuted on Netflix in September 2023.

Netflix streamed the Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Once & Always 30th anniversary special in April 2023.

Digital Eclipse and Hasbro released the Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Rita's Rewind game digitally for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam , and Nintendo Switch in December 2024.

title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 2 Anime Reveals New Promo Video, More Cast
content:
NBCUniversal Japan revealed a fourth promotional video on Friday for the second anime season based on Shigeru Sagazaki 's From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman ( Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru: Tada no Inaka no Kenjutsu Shihan Datta noni, Taisei Shita Deshitachi ga Ore o Hōttekurenai Ken ) light novel series.

The company additionally revealed two more cast members:

Kenshō Ono as Warren Flumvelk

Sumire Uesaka as Shueste Flumvelk

The new season debuted in the "IMAnimation W" programming block on TV Asahi and its affiliated channels throughout Japan on July 8 at 11:45 p.m. (10:45 a.m. EDT). The anime also airs on AT-X and BS Asahi . Amazon Prime Video started exclusively streaming the anime worldwide on July 9 at 12:15 a.m (July 8 at 11:15 a.m. EDT).

Previously announced new cast members include:

• Takashi Kondō as Hanoy Cressa

• Hiromu Mineta as Kuriu Rybark

• Mami Uchida as Prim

• Hiroshi Yanaka as Morris Pasyushka

The anime's returning staff include Akio Kazumi ( Loner Life in Another World , Fist of the Blue Sky Regenesis ), who is again directing the series at Passione and Hayabusa Film . Kunihiko Okada ( The Demon Sword Master of Excalibur Academy , By the Grace of the Gods season 2) is back in charge of series scripts, Satsuki Hayasaka ( The Demon Sword Master of Excalibur Academy , Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki ) is returning to design the characters, and also returning as chief animation director. Yasuharu Takanashi ( Baki Hanma vs. Kengan Ashura , Fairy Tail ) is again composing the music.

Rock band Unicorn performs the opening theme song "Kurenai no Ha" (Crimson Leaf). BLUE ENCOUNT performs the ending theme song "Mikansei" (Unfinished).

The anime's first season premiered in April 2025, and is streaming exclusively on Amazon Prime Video worldwide.

Sagazaki launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in November 2020. Square Enix is publishing the novel volumes with illustration by Tetsuhiro Nabeshima .

J-Novel Club licensed the novel series and describes the story:

Beryl Gardinant, a self-proclaimed “humble old man,” is a sword instructor at his dojo in a rural, backwater village. In his younger years, he dreamed of glory as a master swordsman, but those days are long behind him. Out of the blue, he receives a visit from a famous former pupil who brings him world-shattering news—he's been appointed as special instructor for the knights of the Liberion Order! With his life now turned upside down, Beryl travels to the capital and reunites with some of his former students: elite knights, an ace wizard, and even an adventurer who's attained the highest guild rank possible. But why do they all want his tutelage?! As far as he's concerned, they clearly don't need him anymore. Can Beryl live up to his new position? And will he ever get a moment's peace away from his adoring students?!

Kazuki Satō launched the novels' manga adaptation in Akita Shoten 's Dokodemo Young Champion magazine in August 2021. Yen Press releases the manga in English. The franchise also has two spinoff manga.

title: Kenpachi, Hitsugaya, and Byakuya Fight in BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 44 Preview
content:
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 4 (Episode 44 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes.

The anime premiered early in US theaters with the first three episodes. The fourth episode is titled “THE PERFECT CRIMSON,” and it will premiere on Saturday, August 15. You can see the synopsis and preview images below.

Even with Kenpachi, Hitsugaya, and Byakuya fighting together, they cannot overcome Gerard’s “Miracle.” Driven by pure battle instinct, Kenpachi charges at Gerard, but every time Gerard’s “Sword of Hope” is chipped, it triggers yet another “Miracle,” gradually turning the tables and pushing Kenpachi into a corner. Meanwhile, in the throne room, Ichigo endures Yhwach’s relentless assault while searching for a chance to turn the battle around.

ALSO READ: Interview: Ichigo Voice Actors Masakazu Morita and Johnny Yong Bosch Talk BLEACH BLEACH JET Artbook and Ryogo Narita’s School Life Novel Return, Fan Vote and 2027 Exhibition Announced

BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 44 Staff:

• Screenplay: Masaki Hiramatsu

• Storyboard: Jeong Yeong-hoon

• Animation Director: Jeong Yeong-hoon, Mika Okubo, HAN SEUNGAH, Kazumi Inadome, Kazuo Takigawa, Liu Minxuan

• Chief Animation Director: Kumiko Takayanagi

Created by Tite Kubo, BLEACH was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and concluded with 74 volumes. The manga has exceeded 130 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.

The original anime adaptation aired from 2004 to 2012 and received four theatrical films. The franchise returned in 2022 with BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , adapting the manga’s final arc. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles.

On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High revealed its protagonists in a new trailer, with the game featuring original character designs by Tite Kubo.

title: 'Yowaki MAX Reijō nanoni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta' Anime Casts Shizuka Ishigami
content:
Kadokawa announced one more cast member on Friday for the television anime of Hiro Oda 's Yowaki MAX Reijō nanoni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta (Even Though She's a Timid Young Lady to the Max, She Agreed to Her Shrewd Fiancé's Bet) light novel series. Shizuka Ishigami voices Rufus Stan as a child.

Kadokawa is also streaming a "visual video" featuring a voice drama titled "Aru Natsu no Hi no Futari" (Two People on a Certain Summer Day).

The anime will debut in October, and will star (character name romanizations are not confirmed):

• Miku Itō as protagonist Pia Rockwell

• Ryōta Ōsaka as Rufus Stan

• Rina Hidaka as Caroline Ramsey

• Sora Amamiya as Erin White

• Haruki Ishiya as Henry Cox

Nobuaki Nakanishi ( I Shall Survive Using Potions! , Shin Koihime Musō TV) is directing the anime at Jumondo . Hiroko Fukuda ( Headhunted to Another World: From Salaryman to Big Four! ; Our Dating Story: The Experienced You and The Inexperienced Me ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Moe Hyūga ( The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten , Victoria of Many Faces ) and Natsuki Hamada ( Always a Catch! ) are composing the music at Kadokawa .

Other staff members include:

• Character Design: Hyun Sik Choi

• Prop Design:Shiori Shirosaki

• Background Art: Shunsuke Sakai

• Art Director: Kazuhiro Arai

• Color Design: Hitomi Fujii

• Compositing Director of Photography: Kunihito Noritomo

• Editing: Yūsuke Ueno

• Sound Director: Jin Aketagawa

The romantic comedy centers on Pia, an ordinary grad student who gets reincarnated as a 10-year-old background villainess in an otome game. She remembers the game ends with her engagement with the prime minister's son Rufus Stan called off and her banishment from the land, so she asks Rufus to already break the engagement while they are young. But her request only piqued Rufus' interest in her more, and he makes a bet with her to see if he will really call of their engagement in seven years.

Oda launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in January 2020. That early version has nine chapters and ended with two epilogue chapters. Kadokawa started publishing the novels with illustration by Tsubasa.v in August 2020, and the seventh volume shipped in April 2024. (Oda has since posted more tie-in short stories and spinoffs on Shōsetsuka ni Narō.)

Aji Murata launched a manga adaptation on Comic Walker as part of Kadokawa 's Flos Comic website in 2021. Kadokawa published the manga's fifth compiled book volume on February 16. The overall project has 1.2 million copies in circulation.

title: My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! TV Anime Confirmed, Reveals Visual
content:
An official X/Twitter account confirmed on August 7 that author Kennoji and artist R_ringo 's My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! ( Dōkyo Shiteiru Kensei no Onna Shishō ga Kawaisugite Mainichi Shiawase Desu ) manga will get a television anime adaptation. Deregula is producing the anime. The staff revealed a teaser visual.

Kadokawa 's listing of the manga's second volume in January had previously listed a television anime for the manga.

The manga launched on the KadoComi website in March 2024. The second volume shipped on January 23.

Seven Seas Entertainment announced at Anime Expo in July it has licensed the manga. The company describes the series:

One Man's desire to become strong leads him to a powerful Sword Saint. While she's got plenty of physical prowess and strength, her ditzy personality and stunning looks make her hard to resist! A fun and sexy rom-com manga that will get your blood flowing. Her stats? Stacked. Her power? Unmatched. Her looks? Deadly gorgeous. There's no better mentor to have than Liza Parsandra, a powerful Sword Saint, and Eugene Dawson is the lucky man chosen to be her trainee! But living and training with someone like Liza has unique challenges, especially when it comes to her scatterbrained nature. Between Liza's ditzy moments and tendency towards skinship while training, Eugene has a hard time focusing on the right sword when he's constantly in contact with the beautiful swordswoman!

Seven Seas Entertainment will release the manga starting in June 2027 as part of its Ghost Ship imprint.

Kennoji 's other works include: Drugstore in Another World: The Slow Life of a Cheat Pharmacist , The Girl I Saved on the Train Turned Out to Be My Childhood Friend , I Time-Traveled and Confessed to Ｍy Teacher Crush , and Hazure Skill . Drugstore in Another World: The Slow Life of a Cheat Pharmacist inspired a television anime in July 2021.

title: Sparks of Tomorrow Reveals New Arc Trailer, Yoshihisa Kawahara Joins Cast
content:
Sparks of Tomorrow anime has released a new trailer ahead of the start of its next arc, which will start with Episode 7 on August 16. Yoshihisa Kawahara is also joining the cast as Stewart Smith, a character described as a key figure for the upcoming episodes.

Episode 7 is titled “Elopement”. The new arc will have Kihachi and Inako travel to Shiga, where the missing latter half of the 20th Century Electricity Catalog is said to be located. The anime by Kyoto Animation is streaming exclusively on Netflix . Minoru Ota is directing the TV anime, with Tatsuhiko Urahata in charge of the script. Yuma Uchida voices Kihachi Sakamoto, with Sora Amamiya as Inako Momokawa.

We recently got to interview Director Minoru Ota and Producer Satori Senami about bringing this world to animation. You can watch the new trailer below.

The introduction is described:

A Tale of Adventure for Boys and Girls Who Dreamed of the Age of Electricity in a World Shrouded in Smoke! ──This was a little while ago. Kyoto in the early 20th century, having evolved differently from the history we know today. In a world where only steam engines had advanced, the city was shrouded in smoke. A boy who lost his brother, with whom he had dreamed of the “Age of Electricity,” and now lives with deep suspicion. A girl who keeps her dreams for the future and her regrets for her deceased mother hidden in her heart, now living a devout life. The boy and girl meet while seeking the secret of the “20th Century Electrical Catalog,” which depicted their dreams. Surpass who you are now and break through the dreams you once had! This is the story of .

Main staff:

• Director: Minoru Ota

• Series Composition: Tatsuhiko Urahata

• Character Design / Chief Animation Director: Kohei Okamura

• Worldview Setting: Takaaki Suzuki

• Music: Hitomi Koto

• Animation Studio: Kyoto Animation

Four new cast additions were also announced.

• Hiroshi Yanaka as Jinemon Momokawa

• Mayumi Asano as Naeko Momokawa

• Daichi Endo as Bunshichi Yagura

• Ayahi Takagaki as Tome / Inari

You can watch the new trailer below.

title: Link! Like! Love Live! Game Developer Odd Number Files for Bankruptcy
content:
Odd Number is best known as the developer for Link! Like! Love Live! , the smartphone game app for the Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jōgakuin School Idol Club (Hasu no Sora Girls' School Idol Club) "virtual school idol" project . The game launched in April 2023, and ended service on June 30.

The Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jōgakuin School Idol Club spinoff of the Love Live! franchise is notable among the franchise 's spinoffs for featuring a storyline that progresses with a real-time calendar, and is accessible primarily through Odd Number's Link! Like! Love Live! game. Characters advance their stories in the game in real-time, and have even graduated from the in-story school and exited the main story (which coincides with the "graduation" of the the real-life idols/voice actresses that portray them). The game also streamed live concerts and talk sessions, hosted an idol-training card game, and offered other forms of content that guided the real-time story of the game.

TSR noted that the game had high operating costs for Odd Number, and the game led to a 5,605,290,000 yen (about US$35.14 million) loss for the company by December 2023, which led the company to be 6,821,880,000 yen (about US$42.77 million) in debt at that point.

The company continued to operate the game amid such losses, and it eventually led to business partners getting a provisional attachment from December 2025 to March 2026 on Odd Number's headquarters, which also served as the residence of the company's president.

The Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jogakuin School Idol Club Bloom Garden Party 3D anime film opened in theaters in Japan on May 8. The film follows the final day before graduation of the 103rd class at the Hasu no Sora Girls' Academy.

The project will get a television anime series that will premiere in January 2027.

A manga launched in Shueisha 's Ultra Jump magazine in November 2023.

The Love Live! school idol franchise launched in 2010 and has since spawned the Love Live! Sunshine!! , Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club , Love Live! Superstar!! and most recently, Ikizu Live! Love Live! Bluebird project spinoffs.

title: Live-Action Happy Kanako's Killer Life Season 2 Reveals September 17 Debut
content:
The DMM TV streaming service announced on Friday that the second season of the live-action series of Toshiya Wakabayashi 's Happy Kanako's Killer Life ( Shiawase Kanako no Koroshiya Seikatsu ) manga will debut on DMM TV on September 17. DMM TV also unveiled a new key visual for the second season.

Non and Taisuke Fujigaya reprise their roles as Kanako and Sakurai, respectively.

Tsutomu Hanabusa (live-action Tokyo Revengers ) returns to direct the second season, and is also penning the scripts alongside Ruriko Matsushima and Yūsuke Aose.

The first season of the live-action series debuted on DMM TV in February 2025.

Nishino Kanako sure hates her job, and is only too happy to snag the first new gig that comes her way. She never expected that her interview would be at an agency for contract killers…or that she'd be really, really good at bumping people off! Kanako doesn't have a ton of self-confidence, and adjusting to her new life as an assassin isn't the easiest. Will she ever earn the respect of Sakurai, her prickly but kinda hot new coworker? Find out in this dangerously funny, full-color manga!

Wakabayashi launched the four-panel web manga on Twitter and his pixivFANBOX account, and Seikaisha has since serialized the manga on its Twi4 service. Seikaisha published the manga's ninth compiled book volume on May 27. Seven Seas Entertainment released the eighth volume on July 28.

Wakabayashi's Tsuredure Children manga chronicles a series of short school romance stories in an omnibus format. Wakabayashi launched the manga online in October 2012, and then also began serializing it with new material in Weekly Shōnen Magazine in 2015. The manga ended in July 2018. Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga digitally in English. The manga inspired a television anime that premiered in July 2017. Crunchyroll streamed the series with English subtitles as it aired, and Funimation streamed an English dub .

title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Previews Episode 9
content:
BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA previews Episode 9, titled “Disbandment”. It will premiere on Thursday, August 13 at 11:00 PM JST. The episode is described as follows:

One leaves, one holds on, one steps forward, and one stands still. The other one—hasn’t been able to choose anything yet. They might not be able to go back anymore—

NICHICALINE is animating the series with Osamu Nobusawa and Mochipuyo on character designs.

Mugendai Mewtype (Yumemita) members consist of five female VTubers: Nakamachi Arale (vocals), Miyanaga Nonoka (lead guitar), Minetsuki Ritsu (rhythm guitar), Fuji Miyako (keyboard), and Sengoku Yuno (DJ). This is also the only band among the 10 main bands in the franchise that doesn’t have a bassist or a drummer.

Muse Asia describes the series as: “Waaaaaah!!” Thrown together out of the blue to make their debut, these members each have a spark of unique talent—but they are in absolutely no shape to actually be a band. Can these girls, and their band, really survive this!? “Even when the sound stops, fight back.”

title: Shigeru Mizuki's 'White Flag' WW2 Manga Gets Anime Special on Sunday
content:
NHK announced on Friday that it will air a special anime based on Shigeru Mizuki 's "Shiroi Hata" (White Flag) manga for its NHK Special documentary program on Sunday, August 16. The special is titled "Iwo Jima no Shiroi Hata" (The White Flag at Iwo Jima).

Mizuki's original manga tells the story of an Imperial Japanese Army lieutenant in World War II named Nishiōeda. After fierce and brutal fighting between American and Japanese forces at the Battle of Iwo Jima, Nishiōeda raises the white flag of surrender in order to allow the the troops under his command to live. The surrender went against the army's orders to fight to the death, and Nishiōeda was executed for treason.

Mizuki has said in an afterword to the story that the manga is based on a story he heard about a friend of his older brother, who was an Imperial Japanese Navy officer. The story has never been verified. Mizuki first used the character in his "Futari no Chūi" (Two Lieutenants) manga story, first published in Hinomaru Bunko's Hinomaru magazine in 1964, before reworking the story into "Shiroi Hata," which was published in Seirindō's Garo magazine in 1968. Mizuki used the Nishiōeda character in three different manga stories. Kodansha has compiled four of Mizuki's World War II manga stories, including "White Flag," into a book also titled White Flag , which the publisher released in 2010.

The NHK documentary will show the anime based on Mizuki's original story, as well as research on both American and Japanese reports of a raised white flag and a surrender.

The Battle of Iwo Jima was fought at the tail end of the Second World War, with American forces landing in February 1945. The island saw fierce fighting for about a month, and sporadic fighting with holdout forces for months afterward. For the first time since American forces conducted amphibious landings against Japanese forces in the Pacific campaign, American casualties outnumbered Japanese casualties, despite American forces vastly outnumbering Japanese defenses. Joe Rosenthal took his iconic "Raising the Flag on Iwo Jima" photograph of six U.S. marines raising the U.S. flag to claim victory on the island's Mount Suribachi. American forces eventually built an airfield on the island, which hosted bombers that would later go on to bomb military and civilian targets on the Japanese home islands for months before the war's ultimate end.

Mizuki was born in Osaka in 1922, and he grew up in Tottori Prefecture. He was drafted into the Japanese Imperial Army during World War II, where he injured — and later lost — his left arm. He penned multiple manga based on his experiences in World War II, such as Onward Towards Our Noble Deaths and Watashi no Hibi .

Mizuki was famous for his manga about yōkai — Japanese supernatural creatures. His manga and research into yōkai is largely responsible for the popularity that yōkai stories have today.

Mizuki died on November 30, 2015.
